notes: Entries are SPDX ids or trove classifier names as pip-licenses prints them, minus any trailing parenthetical (case-insensitive; '*' is a glob).
Precedence per license id: deny > warn > allow. An id in no list is 'unclassified'.
SPDX expressions: OR picks the most permissive alternative, AND the least permissive part, WITH is dropped.
Production dependency: deny/unclassified = FAIL, warn = WARN. Dev-only dependency: never fails, deny/unclassified/warn = WARN.
exceptions: package + license + reason + added + expiry (<= 62 days after added). Expired exceptions fail.
